parameter.expression: SELECT PRC.CODPRC AS VALUE, PRC.DESCRABREV AS LABEL FROM TPRPRC PRC WHERE PRC.IDPROC IN (SELECT MAX(P.IDPROC) FROM TPRPRC P WHERE P.CODPRC = PRC.CODPRC) ORDER BY 1

grid.expression: SELECT CODPRODPA, DESCRPA, SUM(SALDOPRODPA) AS SALDOPRODPA FROM (SELECT LPA.CODPRODPA, PROPA.DESCRPROD AS DESCRPA, IPA.QTDPRODUZIR - NVL (PROD.QTDPA, 0) AS SALDOPRODPA FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRLPA LPA ON (PROC.IDPROC = LPA.IDPROC) INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON (IPA.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC AND IPA.CODPRODPA = LPA.CODPRODPA) INNER JOIN TGFPRO PROPA ON (PROPA.CODPROD = LPA.CODPRODPA) INNER JOIN TPRPRC PRC ON (PRC.IDPROC = PROC.IDPROC) LEFT JOIN (SELECT NVL (SUM (I.QTDNEG), 0) AS QTDPA, C.IDIPROC FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON (C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA) WHERE C.TIPMOV = 'F' AND I.USOPROD = 'V' AND I.ATUALESTOQUE = 1 AND (TRUNC(C.DTNEG) >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND TRUNC(C.DTNEG) <= :P_PERIODO.FIN) GROUP BY C.IDIPROC) PROD ON (PROD.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC) WHERE (TRUNC(PROC.DHINST) >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND TRUNC(PROC.DHINST) <= :P_PERIODO.FIN) AND PRC.CODPRC IN :P_CODPRC AND PROC.STATUSPROC IN ('A','F')) WHERE SALDOPRODPA > 0 GROUP BY CODPRODPA, DESCRPA

SELECT DISTINCT PROC.IDIPROC, PROC.NROLOTE, LPA.CODPRODPA, PROPA.DESCRPROD AS DESCRPA, IPA.QTDPRODUZIR, NVL(PROD.QTDPA,0) AS QTDPA, IPA.QTDPRODUZIR-NVL(PROD.QTDPA,0) AS SALDOPRODPA, PRC.DESCRABREV AS PROCESSOPROD, PRC.CODPRC AS CODIGOPRC FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRLPA LPA ON (PROC.IDPROC = LPA.IDPROC) INNER JOIN TPRPRC PRC ON (PRC.IDPROC = PROC.IDPROC) INNER JOIN TPREFX FX ON (FX.IDPROC = PROC.IDPROC) INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON (IPA.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC AND IPA.CODPRODPA = LPA.CODPRODPA) INNER JOIN TGFPRO PROPA ON (PROPA.CODPROD = LPA.CODPRODPA) LEFT JOIN (SELECT NVL(SUM(I.QTDNEG),0) AS QTDPA, C.IDIPROC FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON (C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA) WHERE C.TIPMOV='F' AND I.USOPROD='V' AND I.ATUALESTOQUE=1 AND (TRUNC(C.DTNEG) >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND TRUNC(C.DTNEG) <= :P_PERIODO.FIN) GROUP BY C.IDIPROC) PROD ON (PROD.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC) WHERE (TRUNC(PROC.DHINST) >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND TRUNC(PROC.DHINST) <= :P_PERIODO.FIN) AND IPA.QTDPRODUZIR-NVL(PROD.QTDPA,0) > 0 AND IPA.CODPRODPA = :A_CODPRODPA AND PRC.CODPRC IN :P_CODPRC AND PROC.STATUSPROC IN ('A','F') ORDER BY PROC.IDIPROC
